title: Pokémon Red and Blue
description: Catch, train and battle 151 creatures across Kanto.
overview: Pokémon Red and Blue running in the browser from the pret/pokered disassembly on EmulatorJS (gambatte). Every picture in the game — all 151 creatures front and back, trainers, sprites, tilesets, font and title art — has been redrawn by the clean-room pipeline from coarse facts, so the build ships no original ROM or artwork. Music and sound effects are the original note sequences played by the Game Boy sound channels.
engineLicense: See the upstream project and the clean-room repository
assetLicense: Regenerated clean-room assets; no retail data is distributed
controls: Gamepad — any standard controller, detected automatically
Touch — on-screen Game Boy pad on phones and tablets when no controller is connected
saveInstructions: Save from the in-game menu (Start, SAVE). The save is stored by the build in this browser, under andrewnakas.github.io. Clearing site data removes it. Red and Blue keep separate saves; pick the version with the Red / Blue buttons under the game.
limitations: Regenerated pictures differ from the retail game by design.
Link cable trading and battles are not available in the browser.

verification.scope: Headless tests booted the live build with sound, started a new game and played from the bedroom through Pallet Town and Oak's cutscene, chose a starter and fought the first rival battle.
